settings.content:
Early game:
Deploy small creatures and token generators to prepare sacrifice fodder.

Midgame:
Cast Yawgmoth and begin controlling the board—sacrificing creatures to draw cards, remove threats, and assemble combo pieces.

Late game:

Yawgmoth Combo wins through inevitability, precision, and ruthless efficiency.

settings.text: This deck converts every resource into a massive advantage through sacrifice loops and relentless -1/-1 counter board control. Dismantle opposing armies and draw into your lethal combo finishers for a clean, inevitable victory.

settings.title: Mastering the Physician's Precision
settings.text: Treat your life total as a calculated currency to fuel your engine at the perfect moment. Utilize early fodder to shield your commander and time your graveyard recursion to outlast disruption, ensuring you maintain dominance over the table.

settings.heading: What are proxy MTG cards?
settings.row_content: Proxy cards are high-quality custom alternate art Magic: The Gathering cards, perfect for casual play and testing deck builds without the high cost of original cards.

settings.heading: How is the quality of your proxy cards?
settings.row_content: Our cards are crafted using advanced printing technology to ensure vibrant colors, sharp details, and a premium feel, matching or even surpassing the feel of original cards. Cards are 88 x 63mm, the exact size and thickness of a normal magic card.

settings.heading: How long does shipping take?
settings.row_content: Orders are processed and shipped within 3-7 business days. Delivery times may vary depending on your location, but we ensure fast and reliable shipping.

settings.heading: What if I have an issue with my order?
settings.row_content: Your satisfaction is our priority! Contact us through our contact page, and we’ll work to resolve any concerns promptly. We also offer a full refund for 30 days if you are not happy with your order.
